new_with_model.brief: Creates a new `GtkTreeModelSort`, with `child_model` as the child model.
new_with_model.md: Creates a new `GtkTreeModelSort`, with `child_model` as the child model.

doc.brief: A GtkTreeModel which makes an underlying tree model sortable

clear_cache.brief: This function should almost never be called.
clear_cache.md:
This function should almost never be called.  It clears the `tree_model_sort`
of any cached iterators that haven’t been reffed with
gtk_tree_model_ref_node().  This might be useful if the child model being
sorted is static (and doesn’t change often) and there has been a lot of
unreffed access to nodes.  As a side effect of this function, all unreffed
iters will be invalid.

convert_child_iter_to_iter.brief: Sets `sort_iter` to point to the row in `tree_model_sort` that corresponds to the row pointed at by `child_iter`.
convert_child_iter_to_iter.md:
Sets `sort_iter` to point to the row in `tree_model_sort` that corresponds to
the row pointed at by `child_iter`.  If `sort_iter` was not set, `FALSE`
is returned.  Note: a boolean is only returned since 2.14.

convert_child_path_to_path.brief: Converts `child_path` to a path relative to `tree_model_sort`.
convert_child_path_to_path.md:
Converts `child_path` to a path relative to `tree_model_sort`.  That is,
`child_path` points to a path in the child model.  The returned path will
point to the same row in the sorted model.  If `child_path` isn’t a valid
path on the child model, then `NULL` is returned.

convert_iter_to_child_iter.brief: Sets `child_iter` to point to the row pointed to by `sorted_iter`.
convert_iter_to_child_iter.md: Sets `child_iter` to point to the row pointed to by `sorted_iter`.

convert_path_to_child_path.brief: Converts `sorted_path` to a path on the child model of `tree_model_sort`.
convert_path_to_child_path.md:
Converts `sorted_path` to a path on the child model of `tree_model_sort`.
That is, `sorted_path` points to a location in `tree_model_sort`.  The
returned path will point to the same location in the model not being
sorted.  If `sorted_path` does not point to a location in the child model,
`NULL` is returned.

get_model.brief: Returns the model the `GtkTreeModelSort` is sorting.
get_model.md: Returns the model the `GtkTreeModelSort` is sorting.

iter_is_valid.md:
> This function is slow. Only use it for debugging and/or testing
> purposes.

Checks if the given iter is a valid iter for this `GtkTreeModelSort`.

reset_default_sort_func.brief: This resets the default sort function to be in the “unsorted” state.
reset_default_sort_func.md:
This resets the default sort function to be in the “unsorted” state.  That
is, it is in the same order as the child model. It will re-sort the model
to be in the same order as the child model only if the `GtkTreeModelSort`
is in “unsorted” state.

model.brief: The model of the tree model sort.
model.md: The model of the tree model sort.
